capabilities: Assign icons and colors to files, folders, tabs, tags, properties, and bookmarks
Search Lucide, emoji, Simple Icons, and Devicon icon libraries
Reapply and pin recent icon-color combinations
Automate file and folder icons with rules matching name, extension, path, tags, properties, and dates
Change icons for multiple selected items at once
extras: Runs entirely locally with no network requests; most non-English strings are machine-translated and corrections are welcome; community discussion happens on Discord and issue tracking on GitHub.
intentEvidence: Built on the MIT-0 licensed Iconic by Holo and Better Icons by Christian Lempa.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to set custom icons and colors on files, folders, tabs, tags, properties, and bookmarks from the UI.
